name: sma-wordpress
description: Lets Claude set up So Many Angels events: it reads the website's pages and creates or updates event records. Publishing an event makes the website set up booking, reminders and the event page itself. Claude cannot see or contact any family.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events and whether booking is set up

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event and its set-up status

tools.name: save_event
tools.description: Preview, then create, update or publish an event

username.title: WordPress username
username.description: claude-agent: the separate account with the SMA Agent role. Not your own admin account.

app_password.title: Application password
app_password.description: Created under Users → Profile → Application Passwords for that account. You can revoke it there at any time.
